tasks.label: Stop old LUMAR runtime
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'dotnet|node' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2|LocalWhatsApp|local-whatsapp' }; foreach($x in $p){ Stop-Process -Id $x.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "KILL:$($x.ProcessId):$($x.Name):$($x.CommandLine)" }

tasks.label: Monitor current gateway session
args: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$tokenPath = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LUMAR\\LocalWhatsAppGateway\\gateway-token'; $token = (Get-Content $tokenPath -Raw).Trim(); for ($i = 1; $i -le 4; $i++) { try { $s = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5094/session/status' -Headers @{ Authorization = \"Bearer $token\" } -Method Get; $backend = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 5093 } | Select-Object -First 1; $gateway = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 5094 } | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output \"POLL:$i STATE:$($s.state) LINKED:$($s.linked) CURRENT:$($s.currentNumber) LASTERROR:$($s.lastError) BACKENDPID:$($backend.OwningProcess) GATEWAYPID:$($gateway.OwningProcess)\" } catch { Write-Output \"POLL:$i ERROR:AUTH_OR_STATUS_FAILED\" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8 }"

tasks.label: Find stale node listeners
args: tasklist | findstr /I node && echo --- && netstat -ano | findstr :5094

tasks.label: Inspect node cmdlines
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Inspect node.exe commandlines
args: $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' }; $procs | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Clear stale LUMAR apphost lock
args: tasklist | findstr /I "LUMAR_ERP_API_V2" || echo NO_LUMAR_PROCESS && taskkill /F /FI "IMAGENAME eq LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.exe" 2>nul || echo NO_LUMAR_APPHOST

tasks.label: Clean LUMAR project-owned locks and run LocalWhatsAppFoundationTests
args: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'testhost.exe') -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests|LUMAR_ERP_API_V2' }; if ($procs) { $procs | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"KILL:$($_.ProcessId):$($_.Name)\" } } else { Write-Host 'NO_PROJECT_MATCHES' };" && cd /d D:\YASIN\Backend && dotnet test ".\LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests\LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests.csproj" --filter "LocalWhatsAppFoundationTests" --nologo --logger "trx;LogFileName=localwa_foundation_exact.trx"

tasks.label: Clean stale LUMAR apphost lock and run LocalWhatsApp tests
args: $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'testhost.exe') -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests|LUMAR_ERP_API_V2' }; if ($procs) { $procs | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "KILL:$($_.ProcessId):$($_.Name)" } } else { Write-Host 'NO_PROJECT_MATCHES' }; Set-Location 'D:\YASIN\Backend'; dotnet test '.\LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests\LUMAR_ERP_API_V2.Tests.csproj' --filter 'LocalWhatsAppFoundationTests' --nologo --logger 'console;verbosity=minimal'

args: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LocalWhatsApp.*server\.mjs' }; Write-Host 'BACKEND_PORT_5093'; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5093 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_PORT_5094'; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5094 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_COUNT:' ($procs | Measure-Object).Count; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_PIDS:'; $procs | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize"
